modeSwitch.prompt: Turn the blade. Higashi ignores every resistance and stops healing; Nishi wreathes you in heat; Minami raises the ash; Kita readies the unresistable line.

description.value:
Frequency once per round

Select one cardinal aspect. It lasts until you select another.

  • Higashi: Kyokujitsujin — your Strikes ignore all resistances and immunities, and a creature damaged by your spirit weapon can't regain Hit Points and has its regeneration and fast healing suppressed until the end of your next turn.
  • Nishi: Zanjitsu Gokui — fire immunity, resistance to all damage equal to half your level, and a creature that damages you with an unarmed attack, a melee weapon or a Grapple takes 4d6 fire.
  • Minami: Kaka Jūmanokushi Daisōjin — a 20-foot emanation of ash. An enemy that ends its turn in it must succeed at a Reflex save or be grabbed.
  • Kita: Tenchi Kaijin — readies the 60-foot line whose damage cannot be reduced by fire resistance, Blut Vene or Hierro.
